key_insight: AdaptToken uses an MLLM's own prediction uncertainty (entropy) as a training-free, global control signal to rank tokens/frames across long videos and to stop processing once sufficient evidence is gathered, enabling efficient long-video understanding with minimal performance loss.
problem_solved: Reducing memory and computation for MLLMs on very long videos while providing a principled cross-clip relevance comparison and an automatic stopping criterion so the model need not process every frame.
method: Compute per-token/frame uncertainty (entropy) from the pretrained MLLM's outputs without additional training.
Globally rank and select the most informative tokens/frames across distant clips based on entropy, rather than only within short clips.
Apply an adaptive stopping rule: halt further token/frame processing once overall uncertainty falls below a threshold, saving compute and memory.
impact: Provides a plug-and-play, model-agnostic way to make MLLMs scalable to long videos, cutting inference cost and memory footprint while maintaining accuracy—useful for real-world video applications where compute or latency is constrained.
